definitions.adjacent_pairs: every pair of adjacent adopted chunks overlapping the window
definitions.all_cuts_bridged_kN: every adopted cut inside the window lies inside one chunk with >= N sentence units of the window on each side (clipped to the window)
definitions.best_cov: largest share of the window's characters held by one chunk
definitions.contain: one chunk holds the whole stage-A window
definitions.context_window_k: the max-overlap adopted chunk with k neighbours each side in document order; a passage equal to that chunk (a one-chunk document) reuses its label and is not a new item; passage_tokens counts the new passages only
definitions.new_judge_items: distinct (record, chunk) items among the <= cover_any_cap chunks overlapping the window with no label row in the rechunk label table
definitions.section_wall: a cut at a doc_cut_segments edge; overlap under structure_cuts restarts there
